keys.title: Shortcuts you already know
keys.subtitle: No modes, nothing to learn first. Here is what the keys do.

items.title: Your fingers already know it.
items.text: Save, undo, find, copy, paste. Every shortcut works like everywhere else, and so does the mouse.

items.title: Multi-cursor.
items.text: Select the next match, type once, change them all. Ctrl+Shift+Up/Down adds cursors line by line.

items.title: Format and diagnostics.
items.text: Plugins format your file and point at errors right in the line.

items.title: Nothing gets lost.
items.text: jano keeps a backup while you type. If it gets killed, the next start offers to bring your text back.

items.title: Project settings.
items.text: jano reads .editorconfig. Tabs in the Makefile, two spaces in the YAML, without touching your own settings.

items.title: Undo history.
items.text: Browse every change of the session and jump back to any point.

items.title: Help is one key away.
items.text: Every shortcut, in the editor, always.

keys.macHint: On a Mac it's Ctrl too, not Cmd: your terminal keeps the Cmd key for itself.
